activeAdultUseRetailStoresSource: OCP 2025 Annual Report (December 31, 2025): retail-store line of the 343 total active adult-use establishments (retail + cultivator + manufacturing + testing). Refreshed annually when OCP publishes its annual report.

currentOcpLicenseeRoster.source: OCP Adult-Use Establishments CSV and OCP Medical-Use Registrant CSV via scripts/ocp/fetch-ocp-towns.py (live deduped storefront counts; source dates stored separately)
currentOcpLicenseeRoster.note: Two parallel facts are intentional. The 180 figure on stat cards is the 2025 Annual-Report total of active AU retail-store establishments. The dated live roster records 106 deduplicated AU Store entries in 50 municipalities as of July 8, 2026, and 269 deduplicated caregiver storefronts in 116 municipalities as of July 8, 2026. The roster-level asOf is the older common date. These sources use different dates and definitions and must not be conflated.

dataSource: OCP 2025 Annual Report (stat-card facts) + OCP Adult-Use Establishments CSV fetched 2026-07-08 and OCP Medical-Use Registrant CSV fetched 2026-07-08 (dated live-roster facts).
nextRefresh: Annual-report fields refresh when OCP publishes its annual report (typically Q1 the following year). OCP-CSV fields refresh monthly via `node apps/maine-cannabis/scripts/ocp/refresh-site-stats.cjs` when OCP publishes new CSVs.
notes: Single source of truth for OCP retail-store figures across the site. Preserve the Annual Report and dated live-roster definitions when updating consumers.
